description:
Every `npm run gen-data` (and therefore every `npm run dev`/`npm run build` via prebuild/predev) rewrites the `Generated:` timestamp at line 5 of app/src/data/generated/agents.ts. Result: every developer touching the app produces a one-line dirty diff they didn't intend, and the committed file's timestamp is meaningless (drifts with whoever last built).

Concrete plan:
1. Drop the timestamp comment entirely (cleanest), OR
2. Replace it with a deterministic fingerprint (e.g., sha256 of concatenated substrate file contents) so the line only changes when the substrate actually changes.

Option 1 is preferred — the regeneration-command and source-of-truth comments in the header already convey 'when is this regenerated', and git history shows when the artifact last changed.
title: Arc 10 followup: gen-data timestamp churn pollutes git diff on every build
